description:
Auto req ID:34859
Title:Field Sales Manager
Job Function:Sales
Location:SAO PAULO
Additional Location:
Company:Harley-Davidson Motor Company
Full or Part-Time:Full Time

At Harley-Davidson, we are building more than machines. It’s our passion and commitment to continue the evolution of this storied brand and heighten the desirability of the Harley-Davidson experience. To keep building our legend and leading our industry through innovation, evolution, and emotion we need the best and brightest talent. We stand for the timeless pursuit of adventure. Freedom for the soul. Are you ready to join us?

Our International Markets are focused on creating an inclusive and expanding rider community that appeals to new and existing riders. We strive to deliver an H-D experience with an unequivocal customer focus.

From the UK to Singapore and many places in between, our employees are essential to our success. Our efforts are concentrated on the highest priority markets, primarily North America, Europe and parts of Asia Pacific. We have concentrated our resources in-market for maximum impact in line with our future strategy. Our regional offices and in-market teams have the freedom within a clearly defined framework to make decisions to drive their business. In-market teams are agile and equipped to understand consumer needs, provide focused attention to dealers, and respond more quickly to local market conditions.

Job Summary

The Field Sales Manager will provide the core of the dealer network dedicated, in-field support focused on P&L and sales growth advisory to sustain and improve dealer and company performance. This role will be responsible for driving sales and profit at dealership to meet targets, grow ridership, and increase penetration with existing customers. Success in this role will be defined by your ability to forge relationships, credibility and influence that allow you to become a true consultant advising on sales, growth and profit opportunities as well as key areas for improvement. The field sales manager will develop thorough knowledge of a defined set of dealers and effectively collaborate to navigate changing market conditions, capitalize on opportunities, and continuously improve processes.

Job Responsibilities
  • In conjunction with the dealer, develop and gain buy in for strategic market plan, inclusive of attainment of retail targets, market reports, trending performance and market share. Plans will address growth opportunities and deficiencies
  • Understand drivers of growth and profit for Dealer and be able to apply leading practices to improve performance metrics
  • Conduct monthly vehicle forecasting and market plan reviews
  • Effectively solve problems for the Dealer by leveraging personal experience and knowledge or by identifying the right support link within the organization; identify and request Help Chain support as needed to help Dealers with performance, service, marketing, and operational issues
  • Analyze and review performance metrics at a regular cadence and work with Dealers to adjust as necessary
  • Develop training plan for Dealers in defined market and request support for instructor-led training
  • Enable two-way feedback loop between Dealer and Field Leadership to resolve issues and risks in a timely manner
  • Provide constructive feedback and play an influencer role to drive and sustain dealer performance
  • Act as product experts for H-D products (motorcycle, P&A, GM) and coordinate with Juneau retail managers to manage product line performance
  • Up to 75% travel required
Education Requirements Bachelor's Degree Required Education Specifications Experience Requirements
  • Requires related experience.
  • Requires a solid understanding of financial measures, forecasting and other analytical skills. Ability to demonstrate deep understanding of key financial drivers of Dealer's business, including what best in class numbers should look like
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed aggressive sales performance targets and develop creative solutions to generate results
  • Retail expertise, negotiation and influencing skills and ability to communicate are essential to success
  • Excellent leadership, interpersonal and organizational skills

Harley-Davidson is an equal opportunity employer that continues to build a culture of inclusion, belonging and equity through our commitment to attracting and retaining diverse talent from all backgrounds. We believe in fairness and providing a level playing field for all. We foster a culture that thrives on diverse perspectives and contributions to ignite the creativity and innovation to fuel our business and enhance the employee and customer experience.

We offer an inclusive compensation package for all salaried employees including, but not limited to, annual bonus programs, employee discounts on motorcycles andrelated products, general merchandise, and more. We welcome everybody to join our family and be united no matter who you are or where you come from. Learn more about Harley-Davidson (here ).

Epic Games is looking for a Backend Security Engineer focused on Asset Integrity to protect sensitive game assets from unintended information disclosure. Your efforts will be critical to the success of Fortnite and the many creators who depend on it. The ideal candidate will be well-versed in backend development and have prior experience developing security features. This is an incredible opportunity to contribute to the next generation of Epic’s game development tools.

  • Investigate technical root causes of unintended information disclosure incidents
  • Proactively seek out components in Fortnite backend services that create asset integrity risks, then clearly communicate the problem and recommended solution
  • Build and improve internal tooling at scale to protect the Epic creator ecosystem
  • Handle various real-time issues that may arise on online services and platforms

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, with experience in backend development for games
  • Expert knowledge in one or more of the following programming languages: C++, Java, Go, or TypeScript
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems and design patterns
  • Strong knowledge of AWS/Cloud infrastructure including code-as-infrastructure (e.g. Terraform)

  • Experience working with data analytics to solve, prevent, or monitor for problems
  • Knowledge and/or experience mitigating security vulnerabilities in sandboxes / virtual machines and potential mitigation strategies
  • Experience building or working with CI/CD environments
  • Experience working with building and deploying container images

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. description:

Join to apply for the Remote Site Engineer (IP/Network) role at Speedcast

Overview Of Position
The Sr. IP Network Engineer is an individual contributor with advanced background in IP Network Engineering design, implementation and operation.

Overview Of Position
The Sr. IP Network Engineer is an individual contributor with advanced background in IP Network Engineering design, implementation and operation.
The primary objective of the Sr. IP Engineer within the Edge Network Engineering team is to properly identify customer requirements and establish and deploy a solution which meets the customer’s needs and expectations. This will require disciplined compliance with change management best practices while working both independently and with cross-functional teams; this role will have opportunities to coach team members on complex technical issues, interface with other engineering and support groups internally, and engage with customer IT personnel on complex network/system performance and troubleshooting efforts.
This Sr. IP engineer position provides customer facing global IP network design and implementation, hardware selection and configuration standardization as it relates to network routing protocol, switching and security methodology. As part of the Edge Network Engineering team, the role also includes Tier 4 escalations from the global support organization as well as providing pre-sales technical consultation alongside Sales and Solutions/Systems Engineering teams.
What you will do:

  • Build and maintain customer’s IP network infrastructure within Speedcast Edge network
  • Enforcing Cyber Security policies and hardening of non-core managed network devices
  • Contributes to the development of customer-facing solutions in coordination with Sales/Sales Engineering, Product/Edge Network Engineering teams to ensure optimal solution and supportability
  • Ensure that all engineering parameters and configurations meet the client’s requirements and are being fulfilled on a timely basis
  • Provide 4th level technical escalation support by providing end-to-end subject matter expertise
  • Design and implement customer functional networks such as LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, QoS, and Security/VPN
  • Collaborate with other Engineers around the globe in the design and deployment of new services and/or enhancements/changes to existing network services
  • Advise and recommend technical solutions that will enhance, increase levels of redundancy, survivability and add flexibility to existing global Speedcast systems, network and VSAT Platforms
  • Coach and mentor team members on complex technical issues to deliver the highest level of service to our customers
  • Assist in strengthening IP expertise within the Edge Network Engineering and Customer Support Teams
  • Assist in the development or improvements of network operational best practices and processes to customer network performance, capacity and scalability
  • Ensures that appropriate action is taken to anticipate, investigate and resolve problems in systems and services. Coordinates the implementation of agreed remedies and preventative measures. Analyzes patterns and trends
  • Controls, updates and distributes new and revised quality, configuration and services standards, including technical changes, and maintains documentation
What we need from you:
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (BSEE preferred) but will consider candidates with the right combination of relevant work experience or degrees in related fields
  • Must have at least 7 years of network engineering design and operation experience utilizing various networking equipment from Cisco, Palo Alto, Versa Networks, Juniper
  • Must have proven experience in the application of network design, development and implementation techniques in communications systems that involve a variety of hardware and software suites
  • End-to-end knowledge of various access technologies and networking protocols.
  • CCIE certification preferred but may be substituted with equivalent experience and knowledge of routing, switching and Security/VPN
  • Advanced level knowledge and hands on working experience of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, RIPv2), MPLS and SD-WAN
  • Advanced level knowledge and hands on working experience in designing and implementing complex QoS in a Cisco network environment.
  • Extensive experience with Network Security and VPN design and implementation utilizing Cisco and Palo Alto
  • Extensive experience with WAN optimization technology platforms
  • Experience with Newtec Dialog and iDirect VSAT Platform is a plus.
  • Experience with various VSAT antenna systems such as Seatel, Cobham, Intellian, Sailor, Virgin Technologies, Orbit and Kymeta is a plus
  • Experience with various wireless broadband in offshore communication such as LTE, Inmarsat FleetBroadband/BGAN, Iridium
  • Experience with various NMS and ITSM such as Solarwinds, DataMiner and ServiceNow
  • Experience with network packet analyzer tools such as Wireshark, NetFlow or equivalent and bandwidth measurement tool such iPerf or equivalent tool
  • Able to communicate effectively via written and verbal communications.
  • Excellent problem solver, flexible and able to accommodate changing priorities and directions
  • Must be able to interact effectively within all levels of the company
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and function with minimal supervision
  • Research and analytical skills with the ability to collect access and report factual data and present logical conclusions

description:

They focus on digital marketing services for natural food & beverage companies as well as nonprofit organizations.

Their core services include paid media, social media, email marketing, and influencer relations.


Role Overview

Reporting to the Account Manager, this individual will assist with client communication, task coordination, and project support across digital marketing campaigns, social media, and administrative activities. The position is remote and requires ability to work 6 hours overlap in the 9-5 PST.

Career Growth & Advancement

  • Opportunities to specialize in client strategy, campaign leadership, or team management with demonstrated proficiency and leadership skills.
Security & Compliance Requirements
  • Adherence to internal confidentiality policies and client-specific data handling requirements.
Reporting & Team Structure
  • Reports directly to the Account Manager.

Additional Expectations
  • Active participation in weekly team meetings, training sessions, and ongoing process improvements.

Compensation Structure
  • The compensation philosophy ensures competitive pay aligned with performance, proficiency, and company affordability. Compensation is reviewed annually based on market benchmarks and individual contributions.

ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Oprojeto Acolhidos por meio do trabalho promove a integração de pessoas refugiadas e migrantes venezuelanas por meio de ações de qualificação, empregabilidade e articulação com o setor privado. Santa Catarina é o estado que mais recebe famílias interiorizadas e concentra a maior parte das parcerias com empresas no Brasil. Esse ecossistema local de acolhimento é dinâmico, mas demanda uma articulação mais estruturada para garantir o sucesso da integração.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O(a) Oficial de Operações é responsável por apoiar na coordenação da estratégia de interiorização, assegurando o acolhimento adequado dos migrantes e refugiados venezuelanos nas cidades de destino e promovendo sua integração socioeconômica. Atua diretamente na supervisão de serviços de apoio psicossocial, organização logística, elaboração de documentos e monitoramento das ações nos territórios que recebem venezuelanos interiorizados.

Apoio à estratégia de interiorização:

Apoiar a Coordenação no processo de interiorização, reunindo e organizando todas as informações e ações necessárias para garantir o bom recebimento e acompanhamento das famílias interiorizadas.

Articular com a Coordenação do projeto em Boa Vista as etapas prévias e posteriores à interiorização dos beneficiários.

Logística e suporte às famílias interiorizadas:

Elaborar pedidos de requisição de mobiliários, cestas básicas, kits de higiene e outros insumos, conforme a composição familiar e as necessidades identificadas em campo.

Organizar e acompanhar a chegada dos beneficiários nas cidades de acolhida, assegurando a entrega de itens essenciais e o suporte necessário à instalação das famílias.

Gestão do suporte psicossocial:

Identificar, entrevistar e selecionar consultores psicossociais locais que apoiarão os beneficiários por períodos de 3 a 4 meses.

Acompanhar a atuação desses profissionais e garantir a entrega de relatórios de acompanhamento conforme os padrões acordados.

Monitorar vigência de contratos e apoiar nos trâmites administrativos relacionados ao pagamento das consultorias.

Monitoramento e produção de informações:

Realizar visitas de monitoramento para acompanhar o processo de integração dos beneficiários nas cidades de destino.

Apoiar a coleta e sistematização de dados sobre os beneficiários interiorizados, contribuindo para o monitoramento de indicadores do projeto.

Elaborar relatórios técnicos, descritivos e de acompanhamento das ações realizadas no território.

Apoiar na elaboração, revisão e organização de contratos de prestação de serviço, termos de referência, pedidos de compras e outros documentos administrativos relacionados às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.

Manter a organização e atualização dos arquivos e documentos físicos e digitais de sua área.

Contribuir para a prestação de contas e sistematização de boas práticas junto à equipe local e nacional.

Mobilidade e articulação:

Participar de reuniões estratégicas com stakeholders locais e com a equipe nacional, compartilhando avanços, desafios e oportunidades de melhoria.

Atuar em articulação com a equipe de Chapecó e os escritórios de Boa Vista e Brasília, assegurando alinhamento institucional.

Ter disponibilidade para missões frequentes em diferentes cidades do estado ou do país.

Whether it’s providing clean water to more than a billion people on the planet, producing materials that are essential in everyday technology devices from smartphones to electric vehicles, or protecting workers around the world. Discover the many reasons the world’s most talented people are choosing to work at DuPont. Why Join Us | DuPont Careers

The DuPont Cyrel business stands out as a reference brand in flexographic printing solutions. With the goal of providing high-quality and efficient products for the packaging industry, the DuPont Cyrel business offers a wide range of technologies, including flexographic plates, platemaking equipment and specialized services.

DuPont Cyrel's commitment goes beyond simply meeting customer needs; we seek to lead the market through continuous innovation and sustainable practices that promote efficiency and environmental responsibility.

DuPont DuPont Cyrel business has an opening position of Account Manager located in Barueri, São Paulo. The Account Manager will be responsible for managing and executing the DuPont Cyrel sales strategies for the Packaging Printing portfolio in Brazil.


Your key responsibilities will be/what you’ll do:

  • Managing the direct accounts in Brazil to best promote Cyrel in the market to achieve annual sales.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to provide the technical and marketing support to end customers
  • Accountable for revenue and earnings forecasts, opportunity pipeline development and tracking, and client growth programs
  • Developing customer intimacy to maintain sales relationships and drive growth in the market.
  • Provide market inputs to regional/global marketing plan and drive sales execution of business and marketing strategies.
  • Partner and influence other business functions to deliver performance which impact sales success.
  • Provide monthly and annual demand forecasts for supply planning.
  • Work closely with customers to ensure they are meeting contractual requirements and targeted growth objectives.
  • Coordinate customer training to develop and sustain their value selling capability.
  • Frequent interaction with other sales and technical teams identifying successful approaches and adapting for regional customer needs.
  • Manage launch of new products and if needed, liaise with R&D, Product Management and Technical Services Leaders
  • Define and implement sales expense budget according to sales strategy.
  • Tracking customer performance


Qualifications :

  • At least 3 years of experience in the flexographic printing industry
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Proven experience in sales with strong demonstrated results directly to end user.
  • Market knowledge of dynamics and key players in the market.
  • Ability to influence decision makers throughout the packaging and printing value chain
  • Extensive business success in similar or related industry sector, including elements of product management and senior level negotiation with major customers.
  • Fluent in English, Spanissh skills is a plus
  • Strong presentation and communication skills.
  • Familiar with Microsoft Office package, social media. Power BI skills is a plus
  • Analytical skills and approaches
  • Prepared and able to work in an international business environment with occasionally international travel.

Join our Talent Community to stay connected with us!

We are excited to share that on May 22, 2024, DuPont announced plans to separate(1) into three industry-leading, independent publicly traded companies. This strategic move will create focused businesses with distinct investment profiles. We believe the proposed separations will create opportunities for all three future companies to better serve their customers and unlock long-term value for stakeholders. This process is expected to take 18-24 months from the date of announcement to complete. We are committed to supporting our employees throughout this transition and ensuring a smooth and successful separation process. We look forward to welcoming new talent who are interested in contributing to the continued success and growth of our evolving organization.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment, with a proactive and resourceful attitude; Go-getter mindset, exceptional organizational skills, and strong follow-through on tasks. Excited about leveraging data to enhance your strategic impact within a forward-thinking gaming company. Team player, willing to help out wherever needed.

title: Account Coordinator, Remote
description:
At Bluelight, we are searching for a candidate to join our client's team as a direct hire.

At The Missing Ingredient, we are passionate about building a better future through food. Founded nearly a decade ago by CJ Bruce, with the mission to "uncomplicate marketing for the world’s most impactful food and beverage companies." They specialize in partnering with brands that are conscious about creating healthy food and beverage options and sustainable practices. The team of self-professed foodies and digital marketing nerds is dedicated to exceeding results and driving measurable success for the brands they love.

They focus on digital marketing services for natural food & beverage companies as well as nonprofit organizations.

Their core services include paid media, social media, email marketing, and influencer relations.


Role Overview
  • The Account Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting client account management and ensuring seamless internal operations. Reporting to the Account Manager, this individual will assist with client communication, task coordination, and project support across digital marketing campaigns, social media, and administrative activities. The position is remote and requires ability to work 6 hours overlap in the 9-5 PST.
Key Responsibilities
  • Client & Account Support:
  • Support Account Managers in organizing client deliverables and tracking next steps.
  • Join client calls for note-taking and exposure to client communication.
  • Assist in gathering and preparing materials for client meetings and reports.
  • Maintain up-to-date internal documentation to help Account Managers stay aligned.
  • Step in with administrative or coordination support when Account Managers are out.
  • Offer flexible support to meet the evolving needs of the agency.
  • -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  • Project & Task Coordination:
  • Help track project timelines and ensure internal deadlines are documented.
  • Send friendly reminders to team members about upcoming or overdue tasks.
  • Double-check that briefs and resources are shared before tasks begin.
  • Assist in updating task templates and internal workflows under Account Manager guidance.
  • -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  • Team Collaboration & Communication:
  • Meet weekly with Account Managers to understand challenges and support needs.
  • Check in weekly with internal specialists to surface blockers or support needs.
  • Relay specialist feedback to the Account Manager to help inform planning.
  • Coordinate hand-offs between departments (e.g., creative to paid media) to maintain flow.
  • Help facilitate cross-functional collaboration by keeping communication clear and organized.
Success Measurements
  • Client Satisfaction: Positive feedback and relationship strength with client accounts.
  • Project Delivery: Timeliness and quality of deliverables across campaigns.
  • Internal Coordination: Effective communication and collaboration with internal teams.
  • Task Management: High on-time task completion rate with minimal oversight.
Required Skills & Experience
  • 2-3 years in account coordination, marketing, project management, social media, or related fields.
  • Previous remote work experience and ability to work 6 hours overlap in the 9-5 PST.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Attention to detail and resourceful problem-solving ability.
  • Adaptability to fast-paced environments and openness to feedback.
  • An strong interest in digital marketing and desire to grow in the marketing industry.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and tools like Teamwork, Notion, Slack, and Google Suite.
  • Bonus: Experience in copywriting, content creation, or influencer marketing.
Career Growth & Advancement
  • Potential progression into Account Manager and Senior Account Manager roles based on performance.
  • Opportunities to specialize in client strategy, campaign leadership, or team management with demonstrated proficiency and leadership skills.
Security & Compliance Requirements
  • Adherence to internal confidentiality policies and client-specific data handling requirements.
Reporting & Team Structure
  • Reports directly to the Account Manager.
  • Collaborates cross-functionally with creative, paid media, and influencer marketing teams.
  • No supervisory responsibilities initially but expected to manage tasks and project timelines independently.
Additional Expectations
  • Active participation in weekly team meetings, training sessions, and ongoing process improvements.
  • Contribution to a positive, solution-oriented team culture.
  • Commitment to professional development and continuous learning in digital marketing trends.
Compensation Structure
  • The compensation philosophy ensures competitive pay aligned with performance, proficiency, and company affordability. Compensation is reviewed annually based on market benchmarks and individual contributions.
  • Location: Remote
  • Employment Type: Full-Time
What The Missing Ingredient Offers
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Flexible paid vacation. (You are responsible for ensuring coverage while out)
  • Annual end-of-year profit sharing based on salary, tenure, and performance. Dependent on agency profitability at at the discretion of agency ownership.
  • Guaranteed minimum 3% salary increase YoY, with additional increases based on performance.
  • Ongoing education paid by The Missing Ingredient (courses, books, conferences, etc.), up to $500/year.
  • Opportunities for professional growth across various digital marketing disciplines.
  • Dynamic, collaborative, and mission-driven team culture.

If you are interested please apply.

title: Senior UI Artist
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

As a Senior UI Artist, you will collaborate with UX designers to design features and UX/UI systems by generating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, design systems, and style guides. You will assist the UI Technical Designers and UI Engineers to build out the designs into rapid prototypes and shippable UI to players. In this role, you will have the ability to take wireframes and bring them to life while improving the UX with visuals. You will also implement final art in Unreal Editor using UMG, animations, materials, etc.

In this role, you will

  • Work collaboratively with UX Design, Tech UI Design, and Engineering to create AAA-quality UI experiences
  • Actively participate in the creation and implementation of design systems, game menus, HUD elements, Iconography, UI materials and shaders, UI animation, and motion design
  • Create new material effects, implement basic logic in blueprints, and/or create 2D effects
  • Contribute to shipping high-quality features on time
  • Collaborate with the greater UXUI Department to ensure consistency and quality are maintained across the project
  • Execute at a high-quality bar, work autonomously, and tackle complex features and systems
  • Work in Photoshop, Illustrator, and/or Figma to create concept UI art

What we’re looking for

  • You have 7+ years of experience working collaboratively to see complex UI features through to completion across multiple platforms (mobile, pc, consoles)
  • You have 7+ years of experience working in Agile environments and on multi-disciplinary teams
  • Excellent visual design skills with a strong portfolio
  • You are skilled with Figma, Adobe Suite, or other comparable software
  • A strong portfolio of work showcasing your skills and your process
  • Experience with UI Art implementation, in Unreal Engine (UMG) or equivalent game engine
  • Experience with building UI materials & shaders for game engines, or equivalent 3d packages and FX tools; motion design & UI animation, preferably for games or interaction design
  • You have the ability to see features through to completion and rapidly modify work as information changes
  • You have a passion for making and playing games and have a strong sense of player empathy
  • You are a proactive individual who naturally leans into owning outcomes and is able to deal with ambiguity well and adapt to changes of plan quickly

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Our coverage includes Medical, Dental, a Vision HRA, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance & a 401k with competitive match. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents. Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

title: Senior Editor, The Lancet Regional Health – Americas
description:
Do you enjoy using science to drive change in the world?

Do you have an exceptional eye for accuracy and detail?

About our Team

The Lancet Regional Health – Americas is an open access journal, part of the Lancet's global initiative to advocate for health-care quality and access in all regions of the world. We are an international team, handling high-quality research, reviews, commissions and commentaries to drive thought leadership across all areas of clinical and global public health pertaining to the WHO Americas region. We build close relationships with clinical and research communities to ensure we offer a personalised service to authors while publishing exciting, interesting, and thought-provoking content. We also undertake considerable community engagement and political activities to leverage change.

About the Role

As a Senior Editor, you will work alongside other Senior Editors, a Deputy Editor, and the Editor-in-Chief in all aspects of the organisation and preparation of the journal. You will take ownership of overseeing submissions and performing quality peer review to ensure we publish high-quality content. You will build international relationships with experts in the community to disseminate and discuss practice-changing results from the field.

At the Lancet we are deeply committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment. In our pursuit of excellence, we recognise the strength in varied perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our ongoing efforts to enhance the diversity of our editorial team, we encourage applications from individuals who bring unique skills, backgrounds, and perspectives to the role.

This is a full-time, fixed term position.

Responsibilities

· Identifying experts to act as peer reviewers on selected submissions

· Commissioning and handling special project content

· Write editorials, organise peer review of research articles and reviews, and conduct webinars and podcasts with authors and key opinion leaders.

· Develop and maintain relationships with medical research communities to solicit high-quality research, particularly clinical trials, for the journal.

· Attending conferences and other events, to represent the journal, to identify suitable topics and authors, and to keep up-to-date with current developments in medical research

· Collaborating with colleagues to improve internal policies and processes

· Liaising with other editors, authors, and production teams to perfect papers for publication

Requirements

· A medical degree in a relevant discipline or a higher degree (PhD) in a relevant discipline (eg, biomedical science, public health, global health)

· Have experience in a relevant field or experience in the wider development community

· Demonstrate editorial experience, with a good understanding of all aspects of the journal publishing process

· Outstanding critical analysis and editorial judgment.

· Exceptional organizational skills, capable of managing multiple projects and strict deadlines efficiently.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; public engagement and outreach experience is highly desirable.

· Have a genuine commitment to advancing equity in health and healthcare, with a thorough understanding of social and clinical issues relevant to the Americas.

· Ability to build relationships across diverse communities and to communicate complex scientific concepts to varied audiences.

Work life

We promote a healthy work-life balance across the organisation. With an average length of service of 9 years, we are confident that we offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

For this particular role, we do not expect daily attendance in the office but believe that regular in-person team meetings can be beneficial for us all. You will have a clearly defined schedule of work, and the way you use your weekly hours to complete it will be up to you.

Work in a way that works for you

· Working remotely from home and at our office in a hybrid working style

· Working flexible hours - flexing the times you work in the day

Working with us

We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to help you succeed. Here, you will find an inclusive, agile, collaborative, innovative and fun environment, where everyone has a part to play. Regardless of the team you join, we promote a diverse environment with co-workers who are passionate about what they do, and how they do it.

Working for you

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

· Health care plans and benefits

· Modern Family Benefits, including maternity, paternity, and adoption

· Wellbeing programs

· Life assurance and accident policies

· Comprehensive pension and retirement

· Employee Assistance Programme

· Access to emergency care for both the elderly and children

· RECARES days, giving you time to support the charities and causes that matter to you

· Access to employee resource groups with dedicated time to volunteer

· Access to extensive learning and development resources

Your recruiter will advise you on the benefits package for your location.

About Us

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

You will take ownership of overseeing submissions and performing quality peer review to ensure we publish high-quality content. You will build international relationships with experts in the community to disseminate and discuss practice-changing results from the field.

At the Lancet we are deeply committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment. In our pursuit of excellence, we recognise the strength in varied perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our ongoing efforts to enhance the diversity of our editorial team, we encourage applications from individuals who bring unique skills, backgrounds, and perspectives to the role.

· Exceptional organizational skills, capable of managing multiple projects and strict deadlines efficiently.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; public engagement and outreach experience is highly desirable.

· Have a genuine commitment to advancing equity in health and healthcare, with a thorough understanding of social and clinical issues relevant to the Americas.

· Ability to build relationships across diverse communities and to communicate complex scientific concepts to varied audiences.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
A Unico é a primeira e maior IDtech brasileira, desenvolvendo soluções inovadoras para a proteção da identidade dos brasileiros nas relações com empresas privadas. Queremos colocar o Brasil no mapa global da inovação a partir do desenvolvimento de tecnologias que possam trazer segurança e transparência para as pessoas. Para chegar lá, investimos acima de tudo nas nossas pessoas, que formam um time incrível e comprometido com esse grande objetivo. E aí, vem com a gente?

Nossa cultura

Nossos valores são a base para tudo que fazemos! Aqui na Unico, agimos sem fronteiras; impactamos sem rodeios; somos transparentes mesmo em situações difíceis; resilientes e adaptáveis para evoluir; fazemos a coisa certa do jeito certo e somos ousados ao liderar a construção do futuro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é descontraído e colaborativo, cheio de oportunidades de aprendizado e possibilidades para você desenvolver sua carreira com autonomia e apoio de líderes e colegas.

Como membro do time de product marketing da unico, você será responsável por liderar as estratégias de comunicação do produto, trabalhando junto ao time de produto e de marketing, desenhando planos de go-to-market, participando das cerimônias do squad, e orquestrando a execução junto aos times de vendas. Também será esperado que você participe com o time de gestão de produto e de design das definições de visão do produto, trazendo direcionamentos com base nas necessidades dos nossos clientes, nas demandas de mercado e na solicitação e execução de pesquisas.


Principais responsabilidades:
  • Desenhar, orquestrar e implementar as estratégias de posicionamento do produto: análises de diferenciais, comunicação e mensagens de produto, precificação, entre outros, traduzindo a voz do cliente e necessidades do mercado em um plano de go-to-market efetivo e alinhado com as áreas de vendas, produto, canais, marketing, pesquisa e clientes;
  • Participar da construção e priorização do roadmap do produto junto do time de product management, trazendo insights para o desenvolvimento de produto que nos permitirão alcançar mais casos de uso e ter mais aderência a necessidades do mercado;
  • Fazer análises e ser capaz de entender o produto, o mercado, a concorrência, as tendências e as necessidades dos clientes e do público-alvo;
  • Desenvolver as mensagens, estratégias e planos de comunicação para comunicar features e benefícios novos no produto, além de diferenciais para públicos-alvo generalistas e específicos;
  • Garantir que todos os times de clientes da empresa tenham as melhores informações sobre o produto;
  • Gerir programas de MVP com clientes e parceiros, ajudando a definir métricas de sucesso e entregando as mensagens corretas;
  • Definir necessidades de pesquisa/discovery e trabalhar com equipes de insights para briefing, execução e análise;
  • Trabalhar de forma efetiva com times altamente multidisciplinares, principalmente com o time de produto, sendo capaz de comunicar objetivos do produto e captar necessidades de melhorias, validando e priorizando hipóteses e táticas;
  • Gerir stakeholders e tomar decisões sobre futuro do posicionamento do produto e GTM de maneira independente;
  • Ser criativo(a) e aberto(a) às mudanças. O ambiente é dinâmico, estamos crescendo muito rápido.
Requisitos da Vaga:
  • 8+ anos de experiência na área de marketing de produto/portfólio, ou marketing de campo (field marketing), preferencialmente em um ramo de tecnologia;Experiência de marketing B2B;
  • Experiência com pesquisa e análise de dados;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de estratégias e campanhas de marketing;
  • Experiência como líder independente de GTM e PMM, ou como líder/coordenador de marketing/PMM.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.
  • Ser apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, por vendas, por contar histórias, por entender dinâmicas de mercado e oportunidades;
Competências necessárias:
  • Pensamento estratégico: ser orientado por uma visão macro da empresa e conseguir colaborar para o atingimento de resultados;
  • Trabalhar bem com autonomia;
  • Comunicação: capacidade de falar e escrever em alto padrão, capacidade de defender uma ideia de forma concisa, convincente e estratégica. Ficar confortável em apresentar para grandes públicos;
  • Poder analítico: de diversas fontes de informações, conseguir pinçar e transformar dados em insights e direcionamento de negócios. Ter familiaridade com análise de dados, pesquisas e entrevista;
  • Centrado no cliente / consumidor: conseguir colocar as necessidades das pessoas em primeiro lugar e buscar a solução de problemas nesse sentido;
  • Orientado a vendas: capacidade de transformar produto em valor percebido e ser direcionado por resultados de vendas e adoção de produto;
  • Perfil curioso pelo que está acontecendo no mundo (concorrentes, tendências, tecnologia);
  • Colaborativo: capacidade de se conectar com pessoas para entender seus problemas e compartilhar tomada de decisões.

Conheça os benefícios de se tornar um Ser Unico

Benefício flexível: R$ 1.500 ,00 por mês que podem ser distribuídos nas modalidades VA/VR, Cultura, Mobilidade e Flex Férias;

Auxílio home office: valor mensal de R$ 120,00 para pagamento de contas e consumo;

PLR : e legível a Participação nos Lucros e Resultados conforme acordo sindical;

Benefício Educação: a Unico financia 100% dos estudos para 100% dos colaboradores através de cursos disponíveis na plataforma Unico Skill. Você pode escolher entre graduação, pós-graduação, MBAs, idiomas, cursos especializantes e mentorias;

Bem-estar: acesso à plataformas como Gympass e Totalpass;

Licença parental estendida: 180 dias para gestantes e cuidadores principais do processo de adoção e 60 dias para não gestantes e cuidados secundários do processo de adoção, com salário e benefícios pagos integralmente ao longo de todo o período.

Local de trabalho

Adotamos o modelo de trabalho que prioriza a conexão e engajamento entre os Seres, o nosso #conectaunico, modelo de trabalho híbrido (2x por semana presencial).

E mais…

Oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado de acordo com suas competências e interesses, com oportunidade de crescimento como especialista ou líder, incentivando o seu desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional através de ciclos de avaliação de performance semestrais (com feedback estruturado e plano de desenvolvimento individual);

Para completar a sua experiência, por aqui temos palestras, meetups, workshops, treinamentos, day off no aniversário, reunioff às quartas-feiras, festas e celebrações internas/externas, happy hour presencial quinzenal, grupos de afinidade e ginástica laboral.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Na Unico estamos empenhados em construir uma cultura inclusiva, valorizando em todas as nossas posições a candidatura de todas as pessoas, independentemente de sua etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, política, religião, deficiência, naturalidade ou qualquer outro tipo de característica.

Estamos construindo um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e para nos apoiar em melhores práticas, criamos o formulário de Diversidade & Inclusão. Te convidamos a respondê-lo pra nos ajudar nesse processo, mas deixamos claro que você pode optar por não fazer isso sem impacto na sua avaliação. O compartilhamento desses dados não irá afetar o seu desempenho no processo seletivo e será usado somente para fins de criação de estratégias de inclusão.

title: Junior Operations Analyst
description:
Company Overview

Nestig is a direct-to-consumer brand with a mission to create the most delightful place to shop for children’s spaces. Our brand is synonymous with quality, innovation, and trust, offering customers a seamless shopping experience and exceptional products for their little ones. As one of the fastest-growing consumer brands since 2021, Operations is essential to our culture, and we believe this is a key part of what sets us apart from the competition. We strive to execute streamlined, backend logistics to ensure customers receive their items in a timely and secure way.

Department Overview

As part of Nestig’s Operations team, you will have the opportunity to help provide efficient and complete resolutions for Nestig customers in a practical and detailed manner. You will report to the Operations Lead, Scheduling from the São Paulo office and will be responsible for working closely with all our Operations team, Customer Experience and Product Development teams to ensure customer orders and issues are fulfilled. You will be a driving force in creating exceptional purchase experiences for our customers (we’re talking cribs, kid beds, rugs, wallpaper, and beyond!) through strong analytical and proactive skills and building problem-solving processes that scale.

This full-time position will be based out of our São Paulo office in Pinheiros.


What You’ll Do
  • Plan our international and domestic (USA) shipping schedule;Coordinate with suppliers to set up shipping and delivery in way that works best for our customers and stakeholders;
  • Be in touch with our partner carriers in order to create resolutions for operational incidents and ensure a seamless logistic process;
  • Own the process of solving a customer problem from end-to-end, working closely with our CX team to ensure a speedy resolution to any issues;
  • Follow up on our logistics operation by taking a proactive position to identify problems before customers do;
  • Ability to analyze and synthesize data to guide strategic decisions;
  • Provide analytical insights and reporting to management to keep track of the current experience and improvement over time;
  • Organize all necessary documentation to ensure smooth processes involving our customers and partners;
  • Engage in projects and initiatives to help increase the efficiency of the Operation and improve the Customer Experience;
  • Use your knowledge, skills, and creativity to improve processes and create new opportunities for growth.
What You’ll Need
  • 1+years experience in a similar, analytical role, ideally within an early-stage, growth-oriented company
  • Must be able to work onsite in our São Paulo office three (3) days a week (Monday, Wednesday, Thursday), as well as additionally as needed
  • Proficient English communications skills (B2+), both verbal and written
  • Intermediate Excel skills
  • A passion for all things Operations — you like helping people and problem solving
  • Comfort with the ambiguity of changing priorities, and the flexibility to embrace new ideas within a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated ability to autonomously manage multiple assignments at once, while meeting deadlines and analyzing impact
  • A willingness to roll up your sleeves and wear multiple hats
  • Self-starter with a can-do, team-oriented attitude and ability to stay calm under pressure
  • Legal authorization to work in Brazil (We are available to hire as Freelancer ("PF") or Contractor ("PJ").)
Why You’ll Love Working Here!
  • Total Rewards: dive into our Total Rewards deck to learn more about Nestig’s benefits and perks.
  • Comprehensive medical benefits through Alice for you and your loved ones
  • Twenty-one (21) business days* per calendar year, prorated from your start date, so you can take your well-earned R&R (*What is a business day? A business day is a weekday that the business is open (nongovernmental holiday weekdays). This means that PTO requests will not need to include weekend day(s) and/or governmental holiday(s) that hug a particular day you are requesting off.)
  • Flexible Work From Wherever (WFW) Policy — up to five (5) weeks of remote work per year
  • Monthly wellness, IT, and commuter stipend
  • WFW stipend, so you are able to create a comfortable working environment at home
  • Annual education stipend, because we are always learning
  • Nestig discount, so you can treat you, your family & loved ones!
  • Paid parental leave of sixteen (16) weeks after six (6) months of employment for birthing and non-birthing parents.
What will this interview process look like?
  • We believe that interviews should be a two-way street — an opportunity for us to get to know you, and for you to learn about life at Nestig. To help you feel prepared and confident, we’ve outlined each step of this recruitment process here .

Nestig is an equal opportunity employer, meaning that we do not discriminate based upon race, religion, national origin, gender identity, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected class. We believe that diversity is more than just good intentions, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Analista de Controladoria Senior São Paulo - SP Full-time employee
description:
Job description

O Analista de Controladoria Sênior é um profissional de alta criticidade e visão estratégica, responsável por assegurar a robustez no processo de tomada de decisão Institucional. Com a garantia da integridade dos processos sob sua gestão e do pleno alinhamento com a estratégia de crescimento da empresa, atua diretamente no aumento da eficiência operacional e da alocação dos recursos financeiros da empresa, fortalecendo a sua posição no mercado, por meio de uma gestão financeira sólida.

Este profissional possui um profundo conhecimento das nuances contábeis, fiscais e tributárias, sendo capaz de identificar oportunidades de eficiência, mitigar riscos e propor soluções estratégicas que impactam positivamente os resultados da organização. Sua atuação se caracteriza pela análise crítica, acurácia, compliance, prestação de contas, pela visão de negócios e pela capacidade de transformar dados complexos em insights necessários ao processo de tomada de decisão da alta gestão.


Main responsibilities

  • Estratégia Contábil e Normativa: Assegurar a aplicação correta dos princípios contábeis (CPC/IFRS) e das normas regulatórias, validando os lançamentos e demonstrações financeiras. Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos contábeis, visando aumentar a eficiência e a transparência. Garantir a tempestividade, acurácia e completude das Demonstrações Financeiras como instrumento de gestão e suporte a tomada de decisão. Manter-se atualizado sobre as novas normas contábeis e seus impactos na empresa.
  • Estratégia Fiscal e Tributária: Atuar como ponto focal para questões fiscais e tributárias, garantindo a conformidade com a legislação vigente e identificando oportunidades de otimização da carga tributária. Validar os cálculos de impostos, analisar os impactos fiscais de novas operações e propor estruturas tributárias eficientes. Acompanhar as mudanças na legislação e seus potenciais impactos no negócio.
  • Planejamento Financeiro e Análise (FP&A) Estratégico: Liderar o ciclo de planejamento financeiro (budget e forecast), desenvolvendo modelos financeiros sofisticados e cenários prospectivos. Validar a consistência e a aderência dos dados reportados, analisando criticamente as variações e seus impactos no desempenho da empresa. Atuar como um business partner estratégico, colaborando com as diversas áreas para entender seus direcionadores de custo e receita, identificando oportunidades de otimização e propondo metas desafiadoras. Garantir a eficiência na gestão de custos e despesas da instituição, desafiando permanentemente o seu status e antevendo oportunidades para aumentar a rentabilidade e lucratividade da empresa. Elaborar relatórios de gerenciamento de alto nível, com insights estratégicos e recomendações acionáveis para a alta gestão.
  • Análises Financeiras Avançadas: Realizar a análise crítica do fluxo de caixa, monitorando as variações entre o previsto e o realizado, identificando tendências e propondo ações para otimizar a gestão da liquidez. Desenvolver modelos de projeção de fluxo de caixa de alta complexidade, incorporando variáveis macroeconômicas e estratégias de negócio, para suportar decisões de financiamento e investimento. Identificar e mitigar riscos financeiros e operacionais de forma proativa.
  • Liderança de Projetos Estratégicos de Otimização de Processos/ Melhoria Contínua: Liderar e executar projetos complexos de melhoria e automação de processos na área de controladoria e financeira, como:

Requirements and skills

  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação completa em Ciências Contábeis (CRC ativo é mandatório), Economia, Administração de Empresas ou áreas afins. Mestrado ou MBA em Controladoria, Finanças, Tributário ou áreas correlatas é altamente desejável.
  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência sênior comprovada (mínimo de 8 anos) em controladoria, com atuação estratégica em grandes empresas financeiras ou em consultorias de auditoria e consultoria financeira de renome (Big Four). Experiência em implementação de projetos de melhoria de processos, automação e utilização de ferramentas de BI é essencial.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos:
  • Domínio avançado de princípios contábeis (CPC/IFRS) e normas de auditoria;
  • Domínio da legislação tributária brasileira e planejamento tributário estratégico;
  • Expertise em planejamento financeiro e análise (FP&A), incluindo modelagem financeira complexa, análise de cenários e avaliação de investimentos.
  • Profundo conhecimento em gestão de fluxo de caixa, análise de capital de giro e otimização da liquidez.
  • Experiência comprovada com sistemas ERP (Omie desejável) e ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense).
  • Domínio avançado do pacote Office, especialmente Excel e PowerPoint, para elaboração de modelos financeiros e apresentações executivas.

Additional information

Visão Estratégica e de Negócios: Capacidade de compreender o negócio em sua totalidade, identificar os principais direcionadores de valor e traduzir informações financeiras em estratégias acionáveis.

Pensamento Analítico e Crítico de Alta Ordem: Habilidade para analisar dados complexos de forma estruturada, identificar padrões, inconsistências e riscos, formulando insights e recomendações estratégicas.

Capacidade de Influência e Comunicação Estratégica: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, empática, com capacidade de apresentar informações complexas de forma clara e concisa para diferentes níveis da organização, incluindo a alta gestão. Habilidade de influenciar decisões e construir relacionamentos de confiança.

Liderança e Gestão de Projetos Complexos: Capacidade de liderar projetos multifuncionais, definindo escopo, cronograma e recursos, garantindo a entrega dos resultados esperados.

Orientação para Resultados e Inovação: Foco na entrega de resultados de alto impacto, buscando continuamente oportunidades de melhoria, otimização e inovação nos processos de controladoria.

Adaptabilidade e Resiliência: Capacidade de se adaptar a mudanças, trabalhar sob pressão e manter a performance em ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores.

Ética e Integridade Inabaláveis: Compromisso com os mais altos padrões éticos e de integridade na gestão das informações financeiras e nos processos de controladoria.

Idiomas: Inglês fluente (oral e escrito) será considerado um diferencial.

Certificações (Desejável): Certificações como CPA (Certified Public Accountant), CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst), CMA (Certified Management Accountant) ou outras certificações relevantes para a área de controladoria, finanças e tributário serão altamente valorizadas.

title: Auxiliar de Farmácia
description:
ATRIBUIÇÕES PRINCIPAIS:

  1. Realizar o recebimento dos produtos no Almoxarifado, conferindo os espelhos de entrada e apontando ajustes e correções necessárias antes do armazenamento.
  2. Fracionar e etiquetar produtos conforme critérios padronizados pela instituição e legislação vigente quanto ao controle de validade.
  3. Conferir os espelhos de transferência com os itens físicos, identificando e solucionando divergências junto à liderança.
  4. Manter o armazenamento organizado dos produtos nos setores de Farmácia, seguindo a regra PVPS (primeiro que vence, primeiro que sai).
  5. Apoiar o controle de validade dos produtos, conforme orientação da liderança.
  6. Realizar controle diário de umidade e temperatura do ambiente e refrigeradores.
  7. Atender às solicitações de dispensação e devolução de produtos ao setor e ao paciente.
  8. Conferir, montar, produzir, dispensar e devolver kits.
  9. Atender pedidos de cotas de estoques, subestoques e carros de emergência.
  10. Dispensar os produtos atendidos, registrando em sistema para o cliente interno.
  11. Atender ao cliente interno, via telefone ou pessoalmente na janela dos setores.
  12. Apontar solicitações fora do padrão de consumo ao Assistente de Farmácia ou Farmacêutico para avaliação.
  13. Auxiliar o Farmacêutico no controle e dispensação de produtos não padronizados e de alto custo.
  14. Zelar pelos produtos estocados, evitando perdas e desperdícios.
  15. Solicitar reposição de produtos ao CAF e/ou Almoxarifado conforme rotina.
  16. Apoiar a liderança com informações sobre consumo, giro de estoque, desabastecimento e validade curta.
  17. Executar contagens rotativas e pontuais conforme necessidade.
  18. Participar dos inventários semestrais, seguindo o cronograma da liderança.
  19. Encaminhar notas fiscais e documentos de empréstimo ao Almoxarifado.

REQUISITOS E BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Desejável noções básicas do Pacote Office.
  • Desejável curso de Atendente ou Técnico de Farmácia.

title: Gerente de Estratégia Comercial
description:
A Daki nasceu para revolucionar o delivery de mercado. O que antes alguém recebia em horas ou dias, agora recebe em minutos!
Mais que entregar rápido, buscamos entregar uma experiência incrível para os nossos clientes. Buscamos aquele "UAU" de quando o cliente recebe muito antes do que esperava.
E tudo começa muito antes da montagem do pedido, na verdade, começa bem aqui.
Estamos à procura de um Gerente de Estratégia Comercial para se juntar ao nosso time e assumir responsabilidades estratégicas e táticas essenciais para o crescimento e sucesso de nossas categorias de produtos. A pessoa ideal possuirá habilidades analíticas robustas, além de uma excelente capacidade de gestão de processos e dados.
O que você fará:
Desenvolver e implementar a estratégia de categorias, de acordo com a estrutura e o papel de cada categoria (destino, conveniência, rotina, etc.).
Elaborar estratégias específicas para vendas, margem, escoamento e outras métricas de desempenho.
Definir a estratégia de sortimento com base em benchmarks da indústria, determinando o tamanho ideal do sortimento e fazendo recomendações sobre ativação e inativação de SKUs.
Analisar a profundidade e diversificação de produtos por categoria, garantindo um mix de produtos competitivo e alinhado com as necessidades do mercado.
Suportar o time comercial na execução de processos diários, assegurando eficiência e eficácia nas operações.
Manter a acurácia dos dados disponíveis, implementando procedimentos para a sua verificação e atualização regular.
Buscar melhorias na experiência do consumidor e auxiliar no desenvolvimento junto aos times de Produto.
Liderar e desenvolver uma equipe, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e de alto desempenho.
O que você precisa
Sólida experiência em funções similares de gestão comercial ou consultoria estratégica.
Fortes habilidades analíticas e capacidade de traduzir dados em insights acionáveis.
Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de análise de dados e visualização (Excel, Sheets, SQL, Python, etc.).
Habilidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes multifuncionais e em diferentes regiões.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita em português e inglês.
Capacidade de desenvolver, questionar e implementar estratégias comerciais que impulsionem o crescimento e a rentabilidade.
Experiência prévia em gerenciamento de sortimento e manutenção de bases de dados de produtos é um diferencial.
Informações adicionais:
Estamos em crescimento: Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido, permitindo que o Dakier atue de forma remota e presencial;
Somos Modernos: por meio de um cartão de crédito da bandeira Mastercard, você recebe o vale refeição, dando mais liberdade ao Dakier de como utilizar;
Transporte: realizamos o depósito direto no VT de acordo com a necessidade de passagem do Dakier até a unidade;
Saúde: Hoje disponibilizamos para o nosso Dakier a Assistência Médica e Odontológica, e também o Total Pass;
Mimo: Nossos Dakier tem desconto de 10% em todas as compras feitas em nosso do APP.

Sobre a Daki:
Poucas indústrias passaram por uma revolução tão grande na pandemia da COVID-19 como a do delivery de supermercado. Ao mesmo tempo que muitas empresas consolidadas cresceram ainda mais nesse período, elas ainda não conseguiam entregar uma boa experiência para seus clientes.
E nós sabíamos que o cliente merecia mais. Por isso, resolvemos desenvolver um modelo do zero, com foco total nas pessoas e com a ambição de uma startup que busca a liderança de mercado!
Aí criamos a Daki. :)
Somos o app de delivery mais rápido do Brasil. Entregamos mais de 1000 produtos na sua porta em minutos! Simples, intuitivo e super rápido - para você ter tempo de desfrutar o melhor da sua vida sem precisar perder tempo indo ao supermercado.
Nossos produtos foram cuidadosamente selecionados para atender aos prazeres do dia-a-dia e também às necessidades de uma vida agitada. Temos da cerveja gelada ao carregador de celular, e estamos sempre à procura de inovações que entreguem experiências ainda melhores para a nossa exigente clientela.
Estamos em busca de pessoas que compartilhem essa visão de um mundo mais simples, tecnológico e com foco no cliente, e também que transbordem energia para tirar esse sonho do papel. Se você se identificou, esse é um bom sinal!

Nossos valores:
Na Daki, acreditamos que é possível revolucionar o mercado sem abrir mão do que é mais importante: as pessoas.
Cuidar de você e do outro é essencial para manter um ambiente de trabalho leve, onde todos se sintam seguros, física e psicologicamente.
Colaborar é a chave para o sucesso. Estamos sempre atentos às necessidades e objetivos de todos, porque sabemos que o nosso propósito final é comum: encantar nossos clientes!
Entregar do Jeito Certo significa agir com integridade e ética, enfrentando desafios de frente para garantir a melhor qualidade, experiência e valor em tudo o que fazemos.
Mas não queremos apenas atender expectativas, queremos Surpreender. Ir além do esperado e fazer tudo parecer mágica faz parte do nosso DNA.
Inovar está no nosso dia a dia. Para isso, estamos sempre dispostos a Questionar. Se existe uma forma melhor e mais eficiente, nós vamos atrás dela. Sempre com base em dados e com uma abordagem estruturada para propor mudanças que façam a diferença.
E, claro, também precisamos Curtir o caminho. Celebramos cada conquista – das pequenas até as grandes – com brilho nos olhos, aprendendo com os erros e criando espaço para aquilo que mais importa na vida.
Se você se identifica com essa forma de trabalhar e viver, então você encontrou o seu lugar.

title: Privacy Manager, Regional Data Protection Officer
description:
Job Summary:

About us

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s largest live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. With 550 million fans and operations in over 40 countries, somewhere in the world every 18 minutes a Live Nation Entertainment event takes place. We manage some of the world’s biggest artists, produce some iconic music festivals, oversee world leading venues and, through Ticketmaster, operate one of the largest ecommerce sites. For additional information, visit .

Job purpose

A Live Nation Entertainment, our goal is to maintain the trust and confidence of our fans, artists, employees and partners. Our handling of personal information is designed to put the individual in control, putting them at the centre of all that we do and ensuring that we handle their information in a way that best serves them. In this role, you will be a part of the Global Data Privacy team and help define and lead initiatives to deliver global, cross-jurisdictional privacy transformation in an evolving and dynamic environment. As well as your remit to set local and level privacy requirements, you will have primary responsibility to provide proactive privacy and data protection support in the region. Based out of our Ticketmaster Brasil office, you will also collaborate with other team members to manage local privacy initiatives.

Reporting to the Senior Privacy Manager, you will be a part of a global, dedicated multi-disciplinary information security and privacy team. As Data Protection Officer for specific Latin American countries, you will support the setting of group-wide requirements and owning the data privacy relationship with the business in the region including our Regional Vice Presidents, Managing Directors and Privacy Champions. You will also have the opportunity to work with experienced privacy and information security professionals across the business to align to the Corporate Information Security and Privacy framework.

Role description

Key accountabilities include but not limited to:

  • Support the wider privacy office with the development of standards, policies, provide strategic direction and advice on privacy matters across the region, ensuring such activity is aligned to the global privacy framework and goals of the business.
  • Perform the statutory Data Protection Officer tasks (as outlined by regional/country-specific laws), either personally or via assistance from other functions.
  • Report to the VP, Group Data Protection Officer and RVP’s and MD on data privacy strategy, progress, risks and issues in local markets within the region.
  • Adopt close collaboration with MDs and Privacy Champions to ensure the data privacy and information security framework is tailored to local laws and embraced and embedded into local markets using local resources (including country specific law firms and consultants).
  • Initiate, facilitate and promote activities to foster data privacy and information security awareness throughout the business including implementing privacy by design.
  • Draft and implement required consistent policies, processes, guidance, training and communication in compliance with existing and evolving legislation; compiling records to help demonstrate compliance with accountability requirements.
  • Lead and provide integration support for new markets and acquisitions in the region as part of the Global Mergers and Acquisitions integration team.
  • Support of existing business and systems’ compliance against privacy framework (including internal policies and relevant legal and regulatory requirements).
  • Mentor junior privacy team members including acting as direct reporting line and manager to junior roles within the Privacy team globally.
  • Proactively maintain a detailed knowledge and understanding of relevant legislation, guidance and developments across the Region and throughout the territories for which you have primary responsibility.

Essential Skills

  • Detailed knowledge and experience in applying data protection privacy legislation to a multi-national business’ strategy.
  • Strong risk management skillset, with the ability to communicate risks and solutions in a succinct manner.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills at senior management level with demonstrable ability to bring the business on side.
  • Strong project management and administrative skills.
  • Ability to demonstrate innovative management reporting, compliance monitoring approaches and the ability to implement them.
  • A demonstrated ability to develop sound strategies and improve business processes and controls.
  • Demonstrable ability to be well organised, complete several simultaneous projects on deadline, managing workload and delivery expectations.
  • Understanding and usage of OneTrust and/or similar compliance platform(s), including creation and ownership of templates and integration with existing privacy processes.
  • Strong analytic capabilities and written and oral communication skills.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with proven experience in building relationships with senior stakeholders, peers and business partners.
  • Excellent written and spoken English & Spanish.

Desirable

  • Privacy qualifications (such as IAPP, BCS, CIPP, ISEB or similar) are desirable, however demonstrable practical experience in privacy & risk management would be prioritized.
  • Given the multi-market footprint of the role, relevant additional languages, such as Portugese, are highly valued.
  • Understanding and experience working with and evaluating information security controls and standards.

Equal Opportunities

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It’s talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

The Company

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 500 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000 artists in over 40 countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect over 1,000 brands with the 98 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. description:
Yara Industrial Solutions (YIS) is a global unit within Yara International. Our talented workforce of around 2,000 people in 28 countries and on all continents, capture, transform, and apply nitrogen to create a wide range of industrial products for an even wider range of industries. We continue to grow our knowledge about chemistry to support customers’ own processes and supply chains, making a difference to society every day.

As part of the YIS team, your unique contribution will be valued and acknowledged. We work hard to create an inclusive environment where our people can bring their true selves to work. In YIS you can be confident that your development is on the agenda from day one and that whatever your background you will have the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed.

About the business unit


Cubatão covers the entire operation of four manufacturing plants (CUB1, CUB2 and CUB3) from the handling of the raw material to the dispatch to customers. CUB 1 produces NA (53%,61% and 99%), LDAN, and AN solution 82%, CUB 2 produces Ammonia, NA (53% and 61%), HDAN, AN solution 82%, Sulphuric acid, PhosAcid, and MAP, and CUB3 produces Sulphuric acid, SSP powder and NPKs. The unit stretches across a significant area in Santos, Sao Paolo and is recognized as a responsible employer in the region.

About the Role

As Plant Manager you are passionate about achieving operational excellence and have a genuine interest in helping the company and your employees succeed. You will be responsible for steering the continuous improvement and optimization of all processes in the plant. You will lead a competent team, overseeing the production, maintenance, and safety of the unit to ensure compliance with company objectives, quality systems, and customer expectations.

You are a people-person, with excellent communication and collaboration skills, putting them to good use both inside Yara and with external stakeholders. You care about your assets, your employees, your company and your community. You are innovative and resourceful, and eager to contribute to the prosperity of people and planet.


The position reports to SVP HESQ and Production and is based in the region of Santos, Sao Paolo Brazil.

Responsibilities
• Develop a vision/strategy (road map) for present and future operations.
• Aim for excellence and continuous improvement in the overall site operation.
• Propose, defend, and implement the Business Plan for the coming year, managing the annual budget.
• Prioritize and ensure site adherence to legal regulations and to Yara internal HESQ policies.
• Establish site specific policies and procedures based on the framework set by the Yara Steering System.
• Meet annual volumes and fixed cost targets by ensuring reliable and systematic operations.
• Analyze the need for investments and propose projects in adherence to the Capital Value Process.
• Ensure excellent cooperation within the region on best practices and initiatives; to speed up the implementation and usage of such best practices and to achieve optimal synergies.
• Ensure good relationship with unions and/or employee representatives, creating a good climate for industrial relations, while encouraging a performance culture.
• Promote good social citizenship with external stakeholders such as regulatory bodies, authorities, media, local communities, etc.
• Secure workforce and succession planning, focusing on talents and critical positions; ensuring a proper organizational design.
• Lead and support the development of all direct reports, maximizing competencies and alignment to business demands. Ensuring employees have a clear vision of Yara´s performance culture and values.
• Embody a learning attitude, by remaining curious, and seeking out all relevant sources of information to excel in both technical and people related topics.
• Acknowledge, demonstrate, and encourage a good work/private life balance.

Profile

• University degree, preferably in a natural science or an engineering subject.
• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in a complex site management, production management or project management in the (petro)chemical industry.
• Ability to create accountability and to lead by example
• Strong team building, decision-making and people management skills
• Hands-on mentality and good interpersonal skills.
• Willingness to travel when needed.
• Fluent in English and intermediate Portuguese.

We can offer

• Inclusive company culture and a collaborative working environment.
• International, dynamic working environment in a truly global organization.
• Assurance that your contribution makes a difference.
